driver_of_the_day.label: +12.8 pts v expected
driver_of_the_day.why: Charles Leclerc scored 25 from P2 on the grid; the model expected 12.2.

best_drive_from_back.label: P19 to P9
best_drive_from_back.why: Franco Colapinto gained 10 places from P19 in the 6th-fastest car.

best_strategy.label: +4.0 places through the stops
best_strategy.why: Franco Colapinto's 2-stop race cost 4.0 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 28.3 s in the pit lane
fastest_stop.why: Quickest trip through the pit lane, lap 34 (no stationary times published).

overtake_of_race.label: on Nico Hülkenberg, lap 2
overtake_of_race.why: Lance Stroll passed Nico Hülkenberg for P17 on lap 2 despite being +2.66 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

unluckiest.label: 15.0 points lost
unluckiest.why: Stopped on lap 38, 1 lap(s) before the VSC: P3 before the stop, P20 at the flag.

smoothest.label: 0.307 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: Max Verstappen's corrected clean laps varied by just 0.307 s (1 sd).

team_of_weekend.label: +15.4 pts v expected
team_of_weekend.why: Ferrari's drivers beat the model's expectation by 15.4 points combined.
